title: Reconstructing Reality: A Collective Social Simulation of Belief Propagation from Distributed Evidence

contributions.purpose: 建立错误信息下集体真相重建的仿真框架
contributions.mechanism: 20 智能体在家庭关系事实域上配对交换高置信事实并加性更新信念,比较 Heuristic/同质LLM/异质LLM
contributions.evaluation: 定性框架 + 参数扫描(种群/带宽/阈值/分享策略/轮数)
contributions.source_quote: We present a formal multi agent simulation for studying truth finding under misinformation

contributions.purpose: 证明局部交换可放大真值弱优势达成收敛
contributions.mechanism: 对比三类智能体的 F1/precision/recall
contributions.evaluation: Heuristic F1=0.943(precision 1.000),LLM 均 F1≈0.28(precision≈0.21)——LLM 反而放大错误
contributions.source_quote: We show that simple local exchanges can amplify a weak advantage for true facts into convergence on a complete, accurate knowledge base.

contributions.purpose: 声称识别错误信息负载的相变
contributions.mechanism: (声称)映射真假初始比例的临界阈值
contributions.evaluation: 红旗:Results 未实际给出该相变/临界阈值曲线,贡献未被证据支持
contributions.source_quote: We identify a sharp phase transition in misinformation load at which corrective dynamics fail and the group settles on mostly false beliefs.

contributions.purpose: 分析参数敏感性(分享策略主导)
contributions.mechanism: 对比 strategic vs highest_confidence 及带宽/种群
contributions.evaluation: highest_confidence 使异质 LLM F1 0.262→0.593(但该格 count=1、std=N/A,单样本)
contributions.source_quote: We analyze sensitivity to key parameters, including population size and the initial ratio of true to false items

notes: 自声明 4 条贡献。负结果:LLM 智能体普遍失败(约 4/5 收敛事实为错),仅 2.6% run 自然收敛、97.4% 触顶轮数停机。数据/论证红旗:(1)贡献2/3 承诺的'相变/临界阈值'在 Results 完全未展示——phantom 声明,claim 未支持;(2)分享策略'翻倍'结论基于 count=1 单次运行(Table4 std=N/A),统计无效;(3)Broader impacts 自填 NA'无直接社会影响',与'错误信息传播'主题自相矛盾。与本批 AS0179 主题高度重叠(网络化真相恢复/错误信息),疑似关联投稿。checklist AI 披露:假设 A,实验/分析/写作全 D(Gemini2.5Pro+ChatGPT+Cursor+GRAIL 全自动);自认'results analysis by the AI was mediocre at best'。代码有外链 URL。
